LanguageData.TourniquetApplied.label: tourniquet
LanguageData.TourniquetApplied.description: Stops limb bleeding but cuts off its blood supply. Prolonged use risks gangrene and limb loss. Remove promptly once proper treatment is available.
LanguageData.TourniquetQuicklyRemoved.label: quickly removed tourniquet
LanguageData.GangreneDry.label: gangrene
LanguageData.GangreneDry.description: This tissue is irreversibly damaged. Amputate the affected part; untreated dry gangrene can become infected wet gangrene.
LanguageData.GangreneDry.stages.dry.label: dry
LanguageData.GangreneWet.label: gangrene
LanguageData.GangreneWet.description: Infected dead tissue threatens the patient with fatal sepsis. Amputate the affected part urgently.
LanguageData.GangreneWet.stages.septic.label: septic
